scores.overall_note: This package contains a thoughtfully designed single-document structured editor whose source directly serves the brief: one model derives the editor, preview, validation, and export (source/src/model.js), the seed '结构化编辑与预览一致' is addressed architecturally, skeleton guards plus a 2000-operation invariant test target '编辑不破坏结构', and a11y affordances (focus-visible rings, aria-labels, keyboard-operable preview blocks) are present in code. However, everything observable at delivery contradicts that promise: both operator screenshots show a completely blank initial page, and the sanitized measurement records all seven checks skipped with target_invalid=true. The packaged tree has no dist/ output and its index.html loads raw JSX, so a static open cannot render anything, violating the brief's static-open and ready-at-load constraints. Structural dimensions (navigation cost, context loss) score from the source as the rubric permits, while screen-facing dimensions (salience, understanding, rework) score the blank delivery. The internal self-receipts claiming passes are unverified within this package; per the rubric only the sanitized receipt and screenshots were used for runtime claims. No human-side dimensions were guessed: task_completion_time, information_retrieval_accuracy, and human_preference are not observable here.
